title: Pombos Turcos (Turkish Squabs)
description: Prepared with squabs, bacon, and broth or water.

ingredients.name: one quartilho of broth or hot water
ingredients.sourceText: one quartilho of broth or hot water

steps: After cleaning, cut the squabs in half and braise them in bacon and broth or hot water
When half-cooked, season with all the seasonings
Remove from the broth and place on slices of bread of ló moistened in half a canada of milk that has been cooked with six egg yolks and a little flour until thick
Meanwhile, cook two cardoons cut into small pieces; when half-cooked, remove from the first water and finish cooking in the squabs' broth, seasoning with all the seasonings
Arrange the squabs on the plate, surrounding them with cardoon, and pour the cooked milk on top
Brown in the oven with heat from below and above, and send to the table browned

title: Pombos Velhos em Breza (Old Pigeons in Braise)
description: Prepared with pigeons, bacon, and veal or beef.
steps: Clean and singe the pigeons and lard them with thick bacon
Place them to cook in a braise with slices of veal or beef, roots, onion studded with cloves, and a bouquet of fine herbs, all seasoned with salt and pepper
Cover them all with other slices of bacon, veal, or beef, and place them to braise between two fires
After a while, add a spoonful of broth and a quarter bottle of white wine
Let them simmer gently
When cooked, serve them with sauces and vegetable garnishes that seem best, such as Lombard cabbages, small whole onions, turnips, and peas
They can also be used for terrines and hot pies

title: Popetão de Pombos (Pigeon Forcemeat Loaf)
description: Prepared with veal, beef fat, and pork belly.
steps: Take a little veal meat, beef fat, and pork belly, seasoned all with salt, false pepper, minced shallot, herbs, and fine herbs, and mince it all very well
Once minced, pound it in a mortar with a bread crumb soaked in milk, four egg yolks, and a little grated nutmeg
Line a forcemeat mold with sheets of pork belly
Place part of the forcemeat inside
Put in the middle a ragù of pigeons
Cover with the rest of the forcemeat and sheets of pork belly as below
Put to cook in the oven
When cooked, turn it out onto its plate
Remove the sheets of pork belly and all the fat
Serve with essence sauce and a little cullis as an entrance course

Bind it with three or four egg yolks

Put sheets of pork belly on top
Put to cook in the oven
When cooked, remove the pork belly, turn it out onto the plate
Drain the fat
Serve with sauce of good taste and lemon juice

title: Prato de Tutanos (Marrow Dish)
description: Prepared with bone marrow, broth, and white wine.

ingredients.name: bone marrow from three or four bones
ingredients.sourceText: bone marrow from three or four bones

steps: Boil the bone marrow cut into pieces the size of a thumb in a pan with two spoons of broth
Add half arratel of sugar, white wine, a pinch of salt, chopped herbs, lemon juice, cinnamon, saffron, and all spices
When it has boiled two or three times, pour over two dozen beaten egg yolks mixed with breadcrumbs, cinnamon, and sugar
Brown in a frying pan with low heat underneath and on top so it cooks slowly and takes on good color

Detach from the pan with a spatula and arrange upright on a plate over pastry dough or toasted slices, with three or four egg pasta tubes around the plate, or without them, send hot to the table (for they are not good fried)

title: Pudim de Arroz (Rice Pudding)
description: A pudding made with rice, egg yolks, and brandy.

ingredients.name: rice, cooked in milk and dried
ingredients.sourceText: rice, cooked in milk and dried

steps: Cook rice in milk and dry it
Pound in a stone mortar with butter, ten or twelve egg yolks, grated sugar, seasoned with salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, grated lemon peel, and one drop of brandy
Add the beaten egg whites
Place everything in a dish with a dough border around it and bake in the oven for about one hour
When golden, serve with powdered sugar on top
Note: puddings of vermicelli or any other pasta are seasoned and served the same way

ingredients.name: the crumb of three or four small portions of bread
ingredients.sourceText: the crumb of three or four small portions of bread

title: Pudim à Ingleza (English Pudding)
description: A pudding made with water or milk, beef fat, and raisins.

ingredients.name: one or two pounds of flour
ingredients.sourceText: one or two pounds of flour

ingredients.name: a brandy coin's worth of brandy
ingredients.sourceText: a brandy coin's worth of brandy

steps: Dissolve one or two pounds of flour in water or milk, then add to it chopped beef fat, eight or ten eggs, Alicante raisins, some sugar, a brandy coin's worth of brandy
Season with salt, nutmeg flower, and ground cinnamon
Mix everything together very well, put it in a cloth napkin, and put it into boiling water, and continue to boil for two to three hours
When cooked, let it drain, then remove from the cloth napkin, dust with sugar, and finish with butter sauce

title: Pupelino (Pupelino)
description: Prepared with clarified butter, lemon or orange rind, and flour.
steps: Make a royal dough with a pound of flour mixed with eggs as for dreams
Line a casserole inside with clarified butter, add the dough, and bake in the oven for two hours
When cooked, cut in half with a knife point
Remove all the raw dough from inside, line with clarified butter, dust with fine sugar and finely chopped lemon or orange rind
Place one piece on top of the other, spread butter on the outside, cover with sugar, brown with a hot bread paddle, and serve as a between-course dish

title: Pá de Vitella à Italiana (Veal Shoulder Italian Style)
description: Prepared with veal, veal sweetbreads, and veal tongue.
steps: Take a veal shoulder and carefully lift the skin, leaving it attached only at the tip of the bone, and remove all other bones
Lard the meat with lardoons of thick bacon tempered with salt, pepper, herbs, and a hint of garlic, all finely chopped and dusted with flour, and cover it with its skin
Tie it with twine and place it to cook in a braise
In a separate pan, sauté small onions, sorrel, lettuce, peas, and chervil in good butter and reduce by heat with stock or broth, or broth and braise until cooked and well-flavored
Remove the veal shoulder from the braise, remove the twine, lift the skin
Pour the herb ragout over the meat and cover it with the same skin
Place it on its serving platter with some of the herb ragout underneath, and brush it with clarified butter mixed with two or three egg yolks
Cover everything with grated Parmesan cheese, place it in the oven to brown, and serve hot, cleaning the edges of the platter very well
If you do not have broth or stock, after the herbs have been sautéed in butter and lightly floured, moisten them with milk and thicken with egg yolks also mixed in a little milk

description: A bread preparation made with bread, chicken, and olive oil.

ingredients.name: half a cup of white wine
ingredients.sourceText: half a cup of white wine

steps: Prepare the bread as described above and stuff it with roasted chicken breasts and fry it as the preceding recipe
Cut the morels in two halves
Wash them in two or three waters
Sauté them in a little good olive oil and two slices of ham
After sautéing, dust them with flour
Add half a cup of white wine and one spoon of substance
Season with pepper, salt, a bunch of fine herbs, and one chive studded with cloves
Let them simmer little by little
Once cooked and the fat removed, thicken with a little roux
Place them in their dish with fried bread in the middle and lemon juice
Serve

description: A cake made with sugar, eggs, and flour.
steps: Take one arratel of clean sugar and place in a pot, add fifteen eggs on top and beat with a beater or spoon very well until thick

steps: Place one arratel of clean sugar in a pot, add ten eggs on top and beat very well until thick

title: Quarto de Cabrito de Fricassé Branco (Quarter of Kid Goat, White Fricassée)
description: Prepared with water or broth, truffles, and artichoke.
steps: Remove the shoulder blade from a quarter of kid goat and cut the meat into pieces the width of three fingers, as well as the breast and ribs
Place everything in cold water and then blanch in hot water
When blanched and trimmed, place the pieces in a casserole with butter, a bundle of herbs, salt, and pepper
Place on the fire and dust with flour
Moisten with hot water or broth and add white truffles and half a dozen artichoke stems
When everything is cooked and the sauce is reduced, remove the fat and bind with five or six egg yolks mixed in milk, chopped parsley, a bit of garlic, and nutmeg
When bound and of good taste, squeeze the juice of a lemon and serve hot
It may also be made brown by moistening with substance and binding with a little cullis
If desired, green peas may be added, bound with egg yolks or a little cullis

ingredients.name: spinach ragú, cucumber ragú, peas ragú, sorrel ragú, or other ragú of choice

steps: Place the lamb quarter on a clean cloth and remove the meat in pieces from the inside
Pass the meat pieces through the fire with a piece of butter, salt, onion, and pepper

Tie it with twine or string and place it to cook in a braise
When cooked and well drained of its fat, serve with a ragú of spinach, cucumbers, peas, sorrels, or another ragú of choice

description: Prepared with lamb, bacon, and veal.

ingredients.name: bread crumb soaked in milk with butter
ingredients.sourceText: bread crumb soaked in milk with butter

steps: Once the lamb quarter is roasted and cold, remove all the meat from the thigh and fillet and make a forcemeat with it

Add chilled bacon, half-cooked veal udders, a little beef fat, parsley, green onions, shallots, and truffles, all finely chopped and seasoned with salt, pepper, grated nutmeg, and a dozen dried coriander seeds
Pound everything in a mortar into which you will add a piece of bread crumb cooked in milk with butter, four egg yolks, and some beaten egg whites
Line a pie dish with bacon slices and place the lamb quarter on top, cover it with the forcemeat giving it the same shape
Cover with breadcrumbs and put it to cook in the oven
When cooked and of good color, serve with a sauce of good essence and lemon juice
It can also be served with a garnish in the middle made of veal sweetbreads, fat livers, and truffles, or with a small pigeon ragout, observing that it be well bound, of good taste, and cold

description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and beef fat.

ingredients.name: one thumb-sized piece, loin, or quarter of veal
ingredients.sourceText: one thumb-sized piece, loin, or quarter of veal

ingredients.name: veal meat from the top part
ingredients.sourceText: veal meat from the top part

ingredients.name: bread crumb soaked in cow's milk

steps: Roast a thumb-sized piece, loin, or quarter of veal and let it cool
Remove all the meat from the top part
Make a minced forcemeat with this meat, bacon, veal udders, and all half-cooked ingredients, and beef fat
Season with salt, pepper, parsley, and shallots, and pound everything in a stone mortar
Add a bread crumb soaked in cow's milk and well-squeezed in cloth, eight or ten egg yolks, grated nutmeg, and some beaten egg whites

Place part of the forcemeat on top with a ragout in the middle made of chicken breasts, sweetbreads, truffles, and cooked ham, all cut in dice and well-bound
Cover with the rest of the forcemeat
Smooth it with egg whites and the flat of a knife so it appears whole
Cover with grated bread and place in the oven to cook and brown

title: Quarto de Vitella à Crema (Quarter of Veal in Cream)
description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: three or four canadian measures of milk
ingredients.sourceText: three or four canadian measures of milk

steps: Lard a quarter of veal with thick bacon

Make a marinade with three or four canadian measures of milk, one arratel of pulverized butter mixed with flour, salt, pepper, cloves from India, dried coriander, one clove of garlic, onion slices, and parsley
Heat the marinade and let it cool
Once cold, immerse the quarter of veal in the marinade for ten or twelve hours
Remove the veal when it has absorbed the flavor of the marinade
Dry it in a clean cloth
Place it in a roasting pan covered with bacon slices and paper leaves
When ready, serve with spicy sauce or covered with grated bread with pepper sauce

description: Prepared with lamb, bacon, and onion.
steps: Take two hind quarters of lamb and skin them carefully from the kidney area to the tail, taking care not to tear the skin
Prepare a mixture of scraped bacon, salt, chopped onion, pepper, fine herbs, and fresh butter, all finely chopped and mixed

When roasted, remove the paper and bacon, brush with butter, cover with breadcrumbs, and brown
When browned, serve with meat sauce made of substance with a little cullis, chopped shallot, salt, pepper, and lemon or sour orange juice

Serve with white fricassée sauce or béchamel

title: Rahos de Carneiro com Arroz (Sheep Tails with Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, broth, and water.

ingredients.name: broth from the half-broth preparation, somewhat fatty
ingredients.sourceText: broth from the half-broth preparation, somewhat fatty

steps: Take the quantity of rice needed and wash it very well two or three times with hot water
Cook it in a small pan with ordinary broth, adding a spoonful of the fatty broth from the half-broth preparation
When almost cooked and half cooled, cover the bottom of the plate with a little rice
Arrange the cooked sheep tails on top
Cover with the rest of the rice, preserving each tail's shape
Brush with beaten eggs and when the rice is colored, drain off the fat
Clean the edge of the plate and serve hot as an entree

They can also be served à la Parmesan with a little broth and grated cheese at the bottom of the plate, and when arranged, pour the rest of the sauce thickened with a piece of washed butter over them, cover well with grated cheese, place in the oven to brown, and serve, adding a little broth

title: Raios de Carneiro à Bruziana (Sheep Tails Bruiziana)
description: Prepared with cabbage, bacon, and chives.

ingredients.name: one arratel of entremeared bacon cut into pieces without separating from the rind
ingredients.sourceText: one arratel of entremeared bacon cut into pieces without separating from the rind

steps: Put all the tails, cabbage and bacon to boil in plain water for the space of half an hour
Remove to cold water and squeeze the cabbage very well
Tie it with twine and arrange the tails and cabbage in a small pan with the bacon, six whole onions on top
Season with little salt, whole pepper, a bundle of parsley, chives, two cloves, one head of garlic, and one sprig of fennel
Moisten all with broth without salt and cook slowly until tender
Cut slices of breadcrumb interior in round form the size of new crusados in silver
Pass these through melted butter until they turn golden color
Then put half a handful of flour in the butter that remains in the casserole, return to gentle heat, stirring always until the flour is colored
Moisten it with the same broth in which the cabbages were cooked, with a little vinegar
Cook for half an hour to cook the flour
Remove the tails and cabbages from the pan, drain them of fat, and arrange them on the plate

title: Recheio de Peixe (Fish Stuffing)
description: Prepared with hake, onions, and bread.

ingredients.name: Two portions of hake without skin or bones
ingredients.sourceText: Two portions of hake without skin or bones

steps: Chop two portions of hake without skin or bones
Fry two chopped onions with parsley, and add two beaten eggs with seasonings in the same frying pan, stirring until the eggs curdle
Mix everything with the hake that is chopped on the cutting board, and chop it again with three more raw eggs and five réis of grated bread
Season with all the seasonings, salt, vinegar, and lemon
This mixture can be used to stuff any fish desired, or to fill eggs, eggplants, onions, chicories, lettuces, cabbages, turnips, and artichokes
It can also be made into patties, meatballs, rolls, and everything else desired, adding or diminishing according to the quantity

description: A soup made with turbot, water, and salt.
steps: After cleaning the turbot at the gills and without opening it, wash it very well and serve it in a round pot with a napkin underneath and a half portion of water and salt

title: Rossaquinos (Cheese and Anchovy Appetizers)
description: Prepared with cheese, anchovies, and puff pastry.
steps: Put in a casserole a quart of water, a quarter pound of butter, and some salt stones, and place on fire
When boiling, add two handfuls of flour
When in dough and well dried, place in a stone mortar
Add half a pound of soft and fatty cheese, five or six eggs, two chopped anchovies, and some pepper
Mix all thoroughly and garnish some thin copper molds with puff pastry
Place on each one a piece of this forcemeat the size of a nut
Bake in a moderate oven
After baking, serve as an entrée
Can also be baked in buttered paper and served without dough

steps: Take ten to twelve arrobas of pork meat and pour half a bottle of white wine over it
Wrap in a white cloth
Press it in a press or between two boards loaded with stones
Leave to sit for two days
After that, chop coarsely on a table
Add an equal amount of fat and lard cut into small dice
Season with a little saltpetre, salt, pepper, and fine spices
Add half a bottle of white wine
Mix everything in a bowl and cover for ten or twelve hours
Then fill the larger intestines, tie them equally, and let them drain
After that, smoke them for several days
Once dried, serve them as desired
In the same manner, salchichões of wild boar are made

steps: Mix flour in milk

title: Sopa de Almôndegas à Parrhezã (Parmesan Meatballs Soup)
description: A soup made with partridge, hen, and rabbit.

ingredients.name: crumb of bread moistened in milk
ingredients.sourceText: crumb of bread moistened in milk

steps: Take the breast of partridge, breast of hen, and four loins of rabbit, all raw, and make a minced mixture
Pound it in a mortar and add a small piece of bread crumb moistened in milk but well squeezed
Add melted and strained beef suet, a small piece of well-washed butter, and a handful of grated Parmesan cheese
Add four egg yolks and season with little salt, pepper, grated nutmeg, and some shallots
Pound everything very well
After pounding, form meatballs the size of partridge eggs
Cook them in broth
When cooked, remove them with a skimmer and place in a soup bowl
Serve with another broth and veal substance

title: Sopa de Bocões (Chicken Dumpling Soup)
description: A soup made with capons, bacon, and shallots.

ingredients.name: breasts of capons, hens, and turkey thighs
ingredients.sourceText: breasts of capons, hens, and turkey thighs

steps: Take raw breasts of capons, hens, and turkey thighs, scrape them with a knife and remove all skin and mince them
Pass the minced meat to a stone mortar and pound with scraped bacon, some sage, and two finely minced shallots
When well pounded, add a piece of bread crumb moistened in milk but well squeezed and four or five egg yolks
Season with salt, pepper, and grated nutmeg
Pound again and place on a plate
Make a piece of thin pasta, stretch it so it is very thin
Cut it into strips and place small portions of the minced mixture at intervals, brushed around with beaten eggs
Cover with another piece of pasta
Cut with a mold and blanch in boiling water
Then cook in another broth for six minutes
Transfer to a sieve, place in a soup tureen, and serve with broth and veal substance of good taste and color

title: Sopa de Culi de Camarões (Shrimp Broth Soup)
description: A soup made with shrimp, broth, and sweet almonds.
steps: Wash and cook half a hundred shrimp, remove their heads
Take {{source-1}} and pound them with the shrimp heads and shells, the breast of a roasted hen, and four hard egg yolks
Line the bottom of a casserole with veal stock base, a piece of ham, and an onion in quarters
Cover the casserole with its lid and let it sweat gently over low heat
When it begins to stick to the bottom of the casserole, add one spoon of broth
Season with salt, two cloves, dried marjoram, and sage
Let it simmer gently with some bread crusts
When the veal is cooked, strain the broth through a sieve
Pound the bread crusts with what remains in the mortar and dissolve everything in two spoons of the same broth
Heat, strain through a sieve, put everything together over heat but do not boil
Serve over moistened bread crusts as is customary

steps: Clean and wash the mussels in three or four waters

When they open and come to a boil, remove from heat
Strain the broth through a sieve and remove the mussel shells
Place the mussels in a pot with a piece of butter, some white truffle fillets, cucumber pieces, and fish broth

Season first and to good taste
Pass through a sieve and place on low heat without boiling
Pour over soups cooked in the same mussel broth with stuffed bread in the middle and the white cullis on top

description: A soup made with pigeons, partridges, and duck.

ingredients.name: six lettuce or chicory or Murcia cabbage hearts

steps: In a large pot, braise two pigeons, two partridges, one duck, one rabbit cut in halves, and one chicken in quarters
Add one sausage, one piece of pork, and one arratel of diced bacon
Add herbs, six lettuce or chicory or Murcia cabbage hearts
Add all spices whole, only the pepper ground
Add a large bundle of herbs
When everything is cooked and seasoned with salt and other seasonings it needs, place two breads in a plate or pelangana made into soups and moistened with broth
Let them soak over the same pot
When ready to serve, place all the meat piece by piece on top of the soups
Garnish with lettuce or chicory hearts (everything very well arranged)
Top with lemon juice
Serve at table

title: Sopa à Italiana (Italian Soup)
description: A soup made with mutton, bacon, and wine.

ingredients.name: one and a half canada of water
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half canada of water

ingredients.name: two handfuls of flour and butter in small pieces
ingredients.sourceText: two handfuls of flour and butter in small pieces

steps: Cook two arratels of mutton and half arratel of bacon in a pot with one and a half canada of water, half quartilho of wine, one splash of vinegar, herbs and onions
Stud the onions with cloves and a whole cinnamon stick
When cooked, season with all the seasonings and let it boil
Remove the bacon and mutton so that the broth remains clear
Reduce to three quartilhos
Add a quarter of butter and pepper
Let the broth boil, and when it is boiling, add two handfuls of flour and butter in small pieces
Boil until it thickens, stirring constantly
Add six beaten egg yolks with lemon juice and cinnamon
When well thickened, pour into a plate
Place the mutton on top, which should remain hot
Garnish with lemon slices and cover with cinnamon
Serve at table

title: Sopas de Culí da Rainha (Queen's Broth Soup)
description: A soup made with broth, sweet almonds, and capon.

ingredients.name: A piece of bread soaked in milk
ingredients.sourceText: A piece of bread soaked in milk

steps: Pound in a stone mortar, after shelling, one handful of sweet almonds
When pounded, add the breast of a roasted capon, chopped, four hard egg yolks, a piece of bread soaked in milk, and continue pounding everything very well
When pounded, pass to a casserole, dissolve with broth of veal and ham
Place to heat, and without boiling, pass through fine cloth, heat again, and when hot pour over bread crusts boiled in broth, with their chickens in the middle
This broth serves for all types of white soups, and also for various entries, noting that when for soups, it should be more liquid and less strong

title: Sopas de Patos com Repolho (Duck Soup with Cabbage)
description: A soup made with duck, cabbage, and bacon.
steps: Clean one duck, lard it with thick bacon, sauté it in a casserole with melted bacon, a piece of ham, and two arratels of cow meat
When sautéed, add a little broth and a splash of hot water
Season with salt, one clove-studded onion, and one head of garlic
Let it simmer little by little
When half-cooked, blanch a cabbage in boiling water, squeeze it, tie it with twine, and finish cooking everything together
When everything is cooked, pass the broth through a sieve
Add some bread crusts and a little substance, and place to boil a little
Then remove the fat, garnish with the cabbage and the duck in the middle, and serve
One can also make soups of cabbage or Lombard cabbage with partridges, pigeons, ducks, or teals

sourceSteps: Clean one duck, lard it with thick bacon, sauté it in a casserole with melted bacon, a piece of ham, and two arratels of cow meat
When sautéed, add a little broth and a splash of hot water
Season with salt, one clove-studded onion, and one head of garlic
Let it simmer little by little
When half-cooked, blanch a cabbage in boiling water, squeeze it, tie it with twine, and finish cooking everything together
When everything is cooked, pass the broth through a sieve
Add some bread crusts and a little substance, and place to boil a little
Then remove the fat, garnish with the cabbage and the duck in the middle, and serve
One can also make soups of cabbage or Lombard cabbage with partridges, pigeons, ducks, or teals

title: Sopas de Perdizes e Nabos (Partridge Soup with Turnips)
description: A soup made with turnips, partridges, and bacon.
steps: Clean two partridges, clean them, lard them with bacon, and sauté with two sides of cow meat, a piece of ham, two roots, and one onion with two cloves
After everything is sautéed, add the necessary broth
Pass everything to a pot and place to boil

Meanwhile, cut some turnips into equal pieces, turn them, pass them through the fire in a casserole with melted butter, dust them with flour, and when they are somewhat browned, add a little broth from the partridges
After cooking and without fat, boil some bread crusts in the same broth, garnish with the turnips, place the partridges in the middle, and serve
In the same manner, one makes ducks, ducks, teals, and pigeons

title: Sável Assado (Roasted Shad)
description: Prepared with butter or oil, onion, and lemon.

ingredients.name: One shad, scaled, cleaned, washed, and dried
ingredients.sourceText: One shad, scaled, cleaned, washed, and dried

steps: Scale, clean, wash, and dry the shad
Make an incision along the sides from the head to the tail
Marinate it with butter or oil, slices of onion and lemon, salt, pepper, and fine herbs
After marinating a short time, place it on the grill on both sides
Baste occasionally with the same marinade
When roasted and of good color, serve with well-finished azeitão sauce or with crayfish and caper sauce
It can also be cut into portions and after being fried, served dry or in an escabeche

steps: Place half dozen eggs with three egg whites, half arratel of flour, one arratel of sifted stone sugar, one arratel of very finely ground almonds, salt, one spoon of flower water, and two spoons of well water in a bowl

title: Talmujas (Cheese Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with cheese, dough, and butter.

ingredients.name: Piece of Alenquejo cheese, well fatty
ingredients.sourceText: Piece of Alenquejo cheese, well fatty

steps: Grind in a stone mortar a piece of fatty Alenquejo cheese, a little washed butter, a pinch of pepper, a handful of fine flour, two or three eggs, and a little milk, but in such a way that it is not too thin
Stretch afterwards a dough cake, cut it into square pieces the width of a hand
Put a piece of this mixture in the middle, lifting the corners of the dough upwards
Brush with beaten eggs
Put to cook in the oven
When browned, serve for a side dish

description: Prepared with hare, bacon, and truffles.

ingredients.name: Bacon slices for the bottom and around a terrine dish
ingredients.sourceText: Bacon slices for the bottom and around a terrine dish

steps: Skin one or two hares and remove the meat from the thighs and loins
Lard with medium bacon well seasoned
Line the bottom and around a terrine dish with bacon slices

Cover with beaten veal or beef slices, then with bacon slices
Put the lid on and seal with dough
Cook over gentle heat
When cooked, remove the veal, beef, and bacon slices and all the fat
Add a spoonful of ham essence
Serve hot with lime juice

title: Terrina de Lombos de Lebre para Fiambre (Hare Loin Terrine for Cold Service)
description: Prepared with bacon, brandy, and sausage.

ingredients.name: Medium bacon for larding, seasoned with salt, pepper, spices, sausage, garlic, thyme, bay leaf, and marjoram

After trimming and equalizing them, lard with medium bacon seasoned with salt, pepper, spices, sausage, garlic, thyme, bay leaf, and marjoram, all in powder
Arrange in a small pan with good butter, half a quartilho of brandy, and a bundle of sausage
Cover with veal and bacon slices
Cook over gentle heat for five or six hours
When cooked and with little sauce, arrange the loins in their terrine and pour the sauce over them after passing through a sieve
Cover with the same bacon slices, let cool, and serve for cold service

title: Terrina Real (Royal Terrine)
description: Prepared with partridges, fowls, and pigeons.

ingredients.name: ragù of truffles, mushrooms, sweetbreads, and combs
ingredients.sourceText: ragù of truffles, mushrooms, sweetbreads, and combs

steps: Trim and prepare the following meats and birds
Lard them with seasoned pork belly: two partridges, two guinea fowls, four pigeons, two rabbits, six quails or doves, some pieces of beef loin, and four lamb loins
Season everything with salt, pepper, spices, and fine herbs
Line the bottom of a pot with sheets of pork belly
Arrange all the meats on top, interspersed
Add a layer of parsley, marjoram, and bay leaves
Cover everything with sheets of beaten beef and veal
Top with sheets of pork belly
Cook slowly and gently between hot coals for five or six hours
When cooked, remove the pieces of loin and all the birds
Place them in the terrine that is to be served
Pour over them a ragù of truffles, mushrooms, sweetbreads, and combs well finished
Add to it the braising liquid
Serve as an entrance course

title: Torta de Creme Gelado com Pistáchos (Frozen Cream Pie with Pistachios)
description: A pastry dish made with pistachios, egg yolks, and puff pastry or almond or dough or hazelnut or sugar or flour or eggs.

ingredients.name: Puff pastry or almond dough or hazelnut dough or sugar, flour and eggs dough
ingredients.sourceText: Puff pastry or almond dough or hazelnut dough or sugar, flour and eggs dough

steps: Shell the pistachios, remove the skin and grind them in a stone mortar, wetting them occasionally with a drop of milk
Dissolve the ground pistachios in three quarter-liters of boiled milk with half pound of sugar, a piece of cinnamon stick and lemon peel
When somewhat warm, strain everything through a sieve with twelve egg yolks and return to the fire, stirring constantly with a spoon
When bound and before it boils, let it cool
Place in a freezer with snow around it and stir while freezing as is customary
Serve on bases of almond dough, hazelnut dough or sugar, flour and eggs dough

For frozen fruit pies, when the milk is tempered with salt, sugar, cinnamon and lemon peel with beaten egg yolks, bind it on the fire, and after binding, strain it through a sieve with any fruit cooked first in sugar, freeze as above and serve in the same manner

description: A pastry dish made with cream, egg yolks, and bread.

ingredients.name: Half arratel of grated bread of ló or five réis of grated bread
ingredients.sourceText: Half arratel of grated bread of ló or five réis of grated bread

ingredients.name: One arratel of sugar in thread stage
ingredients.sourceText: One arratel of sugar in thread stage

steps: Place in a pot six bowls of cream, one dozen egg yolks, half arratel of grated bread of ló or five réis of grated bread, and one arratel of sugar in thread stage.
Beat everything very well.
Allow it to boil, and when it is thick allow it to cool.
Make the pie with puff pastry, fill it with the cream mixture, bake it, and send to the table.
The same method is used for curd cheese and milk pies, but milk requires more eggs.
Fritters, almojavenas, and small pastries shaped like half-moons can also be made this way.
Breads of ten réis can also be hollowed out, filled with cream, browned, and sent to the table.

title: Tortas de Ginjas (Sour Cherry Tarts)

ingredients.name: two arratels of sugar at thread stage

ingredients.name: one eighth of flour for French puff pastry
ingredients.sourceText: one eighth of flour for French puff pastry

steps: Remove the stems from two arratels of sour cherries and pass through hot water.
Remove the pits and cook in two arratels of sugar at thread stage with cinnamon and clove.
When very thick, let cool.
Make French puff pastry by kneading one eighth of flour and well worked, spread this dough on the board very well extended.
Place one arratel of cow butter on top, fold the dough so the butter does not appear, and do the same two more times, extending it with the palm of the hand.
Make the tart, put the cherries inside, brush it, and send it to the oven.
In the same way covered box pastries can be made.

description: Prepared with trout, red wine, and meat.
steps: Scale the trout and remove the gills and innards without opening them
Fill the cavity with a piece of butter mixed with a little salt, pepper, and fine herbs
Place in a casserole
Pour one or two bottles of white or red wine so the trout are covered
Season with salt, pepper, a bundle of saffron, fine herbs, and a onion studded with cloves, and a piece of bread crust

Remove the trout
When the sauce is reduced, remove the onion and the bundle
Serve over the trout with lemon or sour orange juice

title: Voee de Flor de Laranja (Orange Blossom Confection)
description: A confection made with orange, juice, and water.
steps: Choose and ensure they are very white, a pound of orange blossoms, boil them for a quarter hour in water, remove from heat, add a pinch of alum stone in powder

Pass it afterward to cold water and lemon juice; from there drain it and place it in sugar at point, and take it to heat repeatedly to warm, but do not allow it to boil
Fill small pots afterward, allow them to cool, cover them, and serve them like the aforementioned ones

title: Xarope de Avença (Maidenhair Fern Syrup)
description: Prepared with water and sugar.
steps: Steep one ounce of maidenhair fern leaves in a quart of boiling water.
Let it infuse over gentle heat for twelve hours.
Pass through a sieve.
Pour this juice into one pound of sugar in the hard crack stage.
Put it in a bowl with gentle and equal heat for two or three days.
When the sugar is reduced and forms a thread that does not break between the fingers, guard it in bottles after it cools, like the preceding ones.

title: Xarope de Orgeat (Almond Syrup)
description: Prepared with sweet almonds, bitter almonds, and melon.
steps: Blanch in hot water one pound of sweet almonds, one ounce of bitter almonds, and four ounces of peeled melon seeds.
Pound it all very well, adding from time to time a small spoonful of water so that it does not turn to oil.
When well pounded and moist, pour into half a pint of hot water.
Let it infuse for two or three hours over gentle heat.
Force through a cloth with a spoon.
Pour what was extracted into two pounds of sugar in the hard crack stage.
Without boiling it and mixing it well, pour it into a bowl.
Cover it with its lid.
Place it over gentle heat with equal warmth, and let it sit for two or three days.
When the sugar is reduced to the consistency of maidenhair fern syrup, put it in bottles and guard it as has been said in the preceding ones.

title: Agnello coi Piselli all'Uso di Romagna (Lamb with Peas Romagna Style)
description: Prepared with lamb, peas, and lard or meat.

ingredients.name: a quarter of lamb from the hind part
ingredients.sourceText: a quarter of lamb from the hind part

ingredients.name: two cloves of garlic cut into strips
ingredients.sourceText: two cloves of garlic cut into strips

ingredients.name: a piece of lard or a slice of cured meat
ingredients.sourceText: a piece of lard or a slice of cured meat

ingredients.name: tomato juice or tomato preserve dissolved in broth or water
ingredients.sourceText: tomato juice or tomato preserve dissolved in broth or water

steps: Take a quarter of lamb from the hind part, lard it with two cloves of garlic cut into strips and with some sprigs of rosemary.
Take a piece of lard or a slice of cured meat and mince them finely with a knife.
Put the lamb on the fire in a pan with this battuto and a little oil; season with salt and pepper and let it brown.
When it has taken color, add a small piece of butter, tomato juice or tomato preserve dissolved in broth or water, and cook it until perfectly done.
Remove the lamb for a moment, pour the peas into the sauce, and when they have boiled a little, put it back on them, cook them together, and serve them as a side dish.
The same method can be used to cook a piece of milk veal in the loin or rump.
In Tuscany these dishes are prepared in the same manner, but only oil is used.

title: Agnello Trippato (Lamb with Egg Sauce)
description: A sauce made with lamb, lard, and garlic.

ingredients.name: lamb from the loin
ingredients.sourceText: 500 grams of lamb from the loin

steps: Cut {{source-0}} into small pieces and fry it with virgin lard.

Make a soffritto in a pan with the fat remaining in the pan, garlic, and parsley, and when the garlic has taken color, throw in the already fried lamb, season with salt and pepper, turn it well, and leave it on the fire for a while so the seasoning incorporates.
Then bind it with the following sauce: beat in a pot two eggs with a good pinch of grated parmesan and half a lemon.
Pour it into the lamb, stir, and when the egg has somewhat set, serve at table.

title: Amaretti II (Bitter Almond Macaroons, Second Recipe)
description: Prepared with white sugar, sweet almonds, and bitter almonds.
steps: Blanch the almonds and dry them in the sun or by fire; then pound them fine in a mortar with one egg white poured in several times.
Having done this, mix in half the sugar, working the mixture with a hand.
After pour it into a bowl and, always working so it incorporates, add half an egg white, then the other half of the sugar and afterwards the last half egg white.
You will obtain, thus worked, a homogeneous mixture of proper consistency that you can shape into a stick to cut into equal pieces.
Pick them up one by one with slightly dampened hands to form balls about the size of walnuts.

Flatten them to the thickness of one centimeter and for the rest proceed as for the previous ones, but sprinkle them lightly with powdered sugar before putting them in a hot oven, and I say oven because a country oven would not be suitable for this paste.
With this amount you will obtain about thirty macaroons.

title: Anatra Domestica col Contorno di Riso (Domestic Duck with Rice Garnish)
description: Prepared with duck, rice, and onion.
steps: Make a mixture with a quarter of a large onion and all the herbs, that is parsley, carrot and celery chopped together with 50 grams of fat and lean prosciutto.
Put it on the fire with two tablespoons of oil and the duck on top, seasoned with salt and pepper.

Once browned, bathe it with tomato sauce or tomato paste and the necessary water to bring it to cook, adding at the same time a pinch of dried mushrooms to cook in that sauce which will then be strained through a sieve and defatted, keeping the mushrooms to add to the rice.

Put the rice, in the amount of 200 grams, raw as is, in a pot with 40 grams of butter and when it begins to take color pour hot water little by little, giving it flavor with the duck sauce and Parmigiano cheese when you are about to remove it from the fire.

title: Anguilla col vino (Eel with Wine)
description: Prepared with eel, wine, and garlic.

ingredients.name: One eel of about half a kilogram or more than one of the same total weight
ingredients.sourceText: One eel of about half a kilogram or more than one of the same total weight

steps: Rub the eels with sand to clean them of mucus, wash them, and cut them into chunks.
Place in a pan one garlic clove cut into thin slices, three or four sage leaves cut roughly, the rind of a quarter lemon, and not much oil.
Put it on the fire, and when the soffritto has taken on color, place the eels in it and season with salt and pepper.
When the stew begins to reduce, loosen them with the tip of a knife so they do not stick, and brown them on one side.
Brown them on the other side, pour in a good finger of red or white dry wine mixed with two fingers of water, cover them, and let them finish cooking over low heat.
Serve them at table with some of their sauce and serve to four people.

title: Anguilla in umido all'uso di Comacchio (Stewed Eel Comacchio Style)
description: Prepared with eels, onions, and celery.
steps: Cut all the vegetables except the lemon into large pieces and boil them with water, salt, and pepper.
Cut the eels into chunks, leaving the chunks connected to each other by a strip of flesh.

Take a suitable pot and make a layer of eel at the bottom, then layer the vegetables mentioned above that are almost cooked (discarding the lemon), then another layer of eel, another of vegetables, and so on until everything is used.
Cover everything with the water in which the vegetables boiled.
Put the well-sealed pot to boil slowly, shaking and turning it, but never stirring with a spoon as you would break everything up.
Surround the pot with ash and embers up to more than halfway, in front of a clear wood fire, always shaking and turning.
When the chunks, which were connected by a strip, become detached from each other, they are almost cooked.
Add a good spoonful of strong vinegar and tomato preserve, taste the broth to correct the salt and pepper (be generous), give it a few more boils, and serve the pot at table.
Serve in hot dishes on bread slices.

title: Anolini alla Parmigiana (Parmesan-Style Anolini)
description: Prepared with beef, lard, and onion.

ingredients.name: Lean beef from the thigh, boneless, 500 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Lean beef from the thigh, boneless, 500 grams

ingredients.name: One quarter of a medium onion
ingredients.sourceText: One quarter of a medium onion

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs from day-old bread, lightly toasted, 100 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Breadcrumbs from day-old bread, lightly toasted, 100 grams

ingredients.name: One egg and the meat broth
ingredients.sourceText: One egg and the meat broth

ingredients.name: Three eggs for the pasta sheets
ingredients.sourceText: Three eggs for the pasta sheets

steps: Lard the piece of meat, tie it and season with salt, pepper and spice scent, then put it on the fire in an earthenware pot or casserole with butter and finely chopped onion to brown it with the butter.
Pour two ladle-fuls of broth into the pot and close it with several sheets of paper held secure by a bowl containing some red wine.

Boil the meat gently in this way for eight or nine hours, to obtain four or five spoonfuls of a reduced and flavorful broth which you will strain through a sieve, squeezing well, and which you will save for the next day.
Form the filling for the Anolini with: toasted breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan, nutmeg scent, one egg and the meat broth. Make everything into a homogeneous mixture.

Make three sheets of pasta kept somewhat tender and fill the scalloped disc, folding it in two to obtain the shape of a small half moon. With this amount you will obtain about one hundred, which will be good in broth or dry like tortellini.
Cook the remaining meat alone or with a side of vegetables and it will be a stracotto.

title: Arigusta (Lobster)
description: Prepared with lobster, onion, and carrots.
steps: Fold the lobster's tail under and tie it before throwing it into boiling water
Flavor the water with a bundle made of onion, carrots, parsley and two bay leaves, adding two tablespoons of vinegar and a pinch of salt
Boil for 30 to 40 minutes depending on its size
Let the lobster cool in its broth
When removed, drain the water by squeezing the tail and after drying it, rub it with a few drops of oil to make it shiny
Send to table with an incision from head to tail to easily extract the flesh
Serve simply seasoned with oil and lemon juice, or accompanied with mayonnaise sauce or other spicy sauce

Alternatively serve with a sauce made as follows: extract the flesh from the head and mince it finely with a hard-boiled egg yolk and some parsley leaves, place the mixture in a sauce boat, season with pepper, little or no salt and dilute with fine oil and the juice of half a lemon, or vinegar

ingredients.name: one large or two small anchovies
ingredients.sourceText: one large or two small anchovies

steps: Take a veal kidney, remove the fat, open it and cover it with boiling water.
When the water has cooled, dry it well with a cloth and thread it lengthwise and crosswise with clean sticks so that it stays open (in Paris silver pins are used).
Season it with 30 grams of melted butter, salt and pepper, and leave it prepared this way for an hour or two.
Given that the kidney weighs 600 or 700 grams, take another {{source-1}} and one large or two small anchovies and clean them.

title: Arnioni alla Parigina (Veal Kidney Prepared in the Parisian Style)
description: Prepared with veal, anchovy or anchovies, and butter.

steps: Take a veal kidney, remove the fat, open it and cover it with boiling water.
When the water has cooled, dry it well with a cloth and skewer it lengthwise and crosswise with clean skewers so that it stays open (in Paris they use silver pins).
Season it with 30 grams of melted butter, salt and pepper, and let it sit prepared for one or two hours.

If the kidney weighs 600 or 700 grams, take another 30 grams of butter and one large anchovy or two small ones, clean them, chop them and crush them with the blade of a knife together with the butter and form them into a ball.
Cook the kidney on a grill, but not too much so that it remains tender, place it on a platter, spread it while hot with the ball of butter and anchovy and serve it to the table.

If the kidney weighs 600 or 700 grams, take another 30 grams of butter and one large anchovy or two small ones, clean them, chop them and crush them with the blade of a knife together with the butter and form them into a ball.
Cook the kidney on a grill, but not too much so that it remains tender, place it on a platter, spread it while hot with the ball of butter and anchovy and serve it to the table.

title: Arnioni per Colazione (Kidneys for Breakfast)
description: Prepared with milk or veal or lamb or pork or kidneys, juice, and bread.

ingredients.name: milk-fed veal, castrated lamb, pork or similar kidneys
ingredients.sourceText: milk-fed veal, castrated lamb, pork or similar kidneys

ingredients.name: five or six slices of bread marrow, dried by the heat
ingredients.sourceText: five or six slices of bread marrow, dried by the heat

steps: Prepare a fine battutino (small chopped mixture) composed of parsley, half a clove of garlic, the juice of half a lemon and five or six slices of bread marrow, dried by the heat.
Open the kidneys to remove the fat and cut them into thin slices crosswise.
For a total of 400 or 500 grams, throw them in a pan with 50 to 60 grams of butter over high heat.
Move them often and as soon as they begin to brown add the battutino, season with salt and pepper and, always moving them with a spoon, pour in the lemon juice and finally a ladle of broth.
The operation should take about five minutes total and before serving pour them over the slices of bread.
This will be enough for four people.

title: Arnioni Saltati (Sautéed Kidneys)
description: Prepared with kidney, white wine, and broth.

ingredients.name: one large animal kidney (or several from smaller animals)
ingredients.sourceText: one large animal kidney (or several from smaller animals)

steps: Open the kidney and remove all the fat as it has an unpleasant odor.
Cut it crosswise into thin slices, place in a bowl, salt it and pour over it enough boiling water to cover.
When the water has cooled, remove it dry and place in a pan to evaporate the water, which you will discard.
Sprinkle a pinch of flour over it, add a small piece of butter and, stirring often, let it grill for only five minutes.

Season with salt, pepper and a scant half glass of white wine, leave it briefly longer on the heat and when about to remove it add another small piece of butter, a pinch of chopped parsley and a bit of broth if needed.
Note: kidneys held too long on the heat become tough. It is good to boil the wine separately first until reduced by a third; if instead of white wine you use marsala or champagne, so much the better.

title: Arrosto di Lepre I (Roasted Hare I)
description: Prepared with hare, vinegar, and shallots.

ingredients.name: half a glass of vinegar or less
ingredients.sourceText: half a glass of vinegar or less

steps: Infuse the hare for twelve to fourteen hours in a liquid prepared as follows: put on the fire three glasses of water with half a glass of vinegar or less in proportion to the size, three or four chopped shallots, one or two bay leaves, a small bunch of parsley, a bit of salt and a pinch of pepper; boil for five or six minutes and pour cold over the hare.
Remove from infusion and dry it well.
Stud it entirely with fine lardons using a larding needle.
Cook over gentle heat, salt sufficiently and baste with cream and nothing else.

steps: Stud the meat with the ham slices using a larding needle.
Tie it with string to keep it compact and place it in a pot with butter, onion pieces, celery ribs and carrot strips.
Season with salt and pepper and when the meat has browned, turning it often, moisten with two small ladles of water.

title: Baccalà montebianco (Salt Cod Montebianco)
description: Prepared with salt, cream or milk, and oil.
steps: Clean the salt cod of its bones, small bones, skin and sinews, which present themselves like threads; this will leave approximately 340 grams of cleaned cod.
After having prepared it thus, pound it in a mortar and then place it in a small pot, together with the cream or milk, over a fire that is not too hot, stirring continuously.

When it has absorbed the cream or milk, begin to pour the oil drop by drop, as you would do for mayonnaise, always working it very much with the "wielded weapon", that is with the wooden spoon, so that it becomes refined and does not separate.
Remove it when it seems to you cooked to the point and serve it cold with a garnish of raw truffles cut into very thin slices, or with slices of fried bread, or caviar crostini.
This quantity can suffice for eight persons.

title: Balsamella (Béchamel Sauce)
description: A sauce made with flour, butter, and milk.

ingredients.name: Butter, the volume of an egg
ingredients.sourceText: Butter, the volume of an egg

ingredients.name: Milk, half a liter of the best
ingredients.sourceText: Milk, half a liter of the best

steps: Put in a pan on the fire a tablespoon of flour and a piece of butter the volume of an egg.

Use a spoon to dissolve the butter and flour together and when this begins to take a hazelnut color, pour in half a liter of the best milk little by little, stirring continuously with the spoon until you see the liquid thickened like a cream of milky color.
This is the balsamella.
If it becomes too thick add milk, if too thin put it back on the fire with another small piece of butter mixed with flour.
The dose is abundant, but you can proportion it according to circumstances.

title: Bianco Mangiare (Almond Blancmange)
description: Prepared with sweet almonds, powdered sugar, and fish.

ingredients.name: Sweet almonds with three bitter almonds, 150 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Sweet almonds with three bitter almonds, 150 grams

ingredients.name: Cream or milk, half a glass
ingredients.sourceText: Cream or milk, half a glass

ingredients.name: Water, one and a half glasses
ingredients.sourceText: Water, one and a half glasses

steps: First prepare the fish gelatin by pressing it with your fingers at the bottom of a glass, cover it with water and let it soften, then when you need it, discard the water and wash it

Shell and pound the almonds in a mortar, moistening them from time to time with a teaspoon of water, and when you have reduced them to a fine paste, dilute them with the aforementioned water and pass them through a strong, fine cloth, taking care to extract all the substance
At this point, prepare a mold of appropriate capacity
Then put on the fire in a pan the almond milk, the cream, the sugar, the gelatin, the orange blossom water; mix everything together and let it boil for a few minutes
Remove it from the fire and when it has cooled, pour it into the mold immersed in fresh water or ice
To unmold it, simply pass a cloth dampened in boiling water around the mold
Note: boiling is necessary so that the fish gelatin incorporates with the rest; otherwise it may precipitate to the bottom of the mold

title: Biscotti Croccanti I (Crunchy Biscuits I)
description: A biscuit made with powdered sugar, sweet almonds, and flour.

ingredients.name: Sweet almonds, whole and blanched mixed with some pine nuts, 120 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Sweet almonds, whole and blanched mixed with some pine nuts, 120 grams

steps: Set aside the almonds and pine nuts to add later.
Mix everything together with four eggs, keeping the fifth egg in reserve in case it is needed to form a somewhat soft dough.
Make four loaves the thickness of a finger and as wide as a hand.
Place them on a baking sheet buttered and floured, and gild them on top.
Do not bake them so much that they cannot be sliced, which will be better done the next day when the crust softens.
Put the slices back in the oven to toast them lightly on both sides, and you will have crunchy biscuits.

steps: These biscuits are finer than the previous ones.
Blanch the almonds, and leave both these and the pine nuts whole.
Cut the candied fruit into small pieces.
Make a well in the mound of flour and place the eggs, sugar, butter, spirits, and baking soda in it.
Mix the dough without working it too much, then open it and spread it to add the rest.
Roll out a somewhat compressed stick about one meter long, divide it into four or five parts so it fits in the baking sheet.
Gild it and bake it in the oven.
Once baked, cut it in the shape of biscuits into slices slightly thicker than one centimeter.
Toast them lightly on both sides.

title: Biscotto (Sponge Cake)
description: A cake made with powdered sugar, wheat flour, and potato flour.
steps: Work for at least half an hour the egg yolks with the sugar and one tablespoon of the said flours, using a spoon. title: Biscotto alla Sultana (Sultan's Cookie)
description: Prepared with powdered sugar, wheat flour, and potato flour.
steps: First place on the fire the raisins and candied fruit cut to the size of watermelon seeds with enough cognac or rum to cover them; when this boils, ignite it and let it burn outside the fire until the liquor is consumed; then remove this mixture and let it dry among the folds of a towel
After this operation, work very well with a wooden spoon for half an hour the sugar and egg yolks where you have placed the lemon zest

Beat the egg whites until stiff with a whisk, and pour them into the mixture; then add the two flours letting them fall through a small sieve and at the same time mix slowly and gently so that everything combines well, without working it too much
Finally add the raisins, candied fruit and the two tablespoons of rum or cognac mentioned and pour the mixture into a smooth mold or in a copper pot that gives the dessert a tall and round shape

Butter the mold and dust it with powdered sugar and flour, being careful to put it in the oven immediately to prevent the raisins and candied fruit from sinking to the bottom. If this happens, another time leave out one egg white
Serve cold

title: Bistecca alla Fiorentina (Florentine-Style Steak)
description: Prepared with beef steak, salt, and pepper.

ingredients.name: beef steak from the loin, thick as one or one and a half fingers
ingredients.sourceText: beef steak from the loin, thick as one or one and a half fingers

steps: Place the steak on the grill over hot charcoal, either natural as it comes from the animal or at most washed and dried.
Turn it several times and season with salt and pepper when it is cooked.
Send it to table with a small piece of butter on top.
It should not be too cooked because its beauty is that when you cut it, it releases abundant juice on the plate.
Do not salt it before cooking because the heat will dry it, and if you season it beforehand with oil or other things, as many do, it will taste rancid and be nauseating.

title: Bocconi di Pane Ripieni (Stuffed Bread Morsels)
description: A bread preparation made with bread, chicken, and veal sweetbreads.

ingredients.name: chicken or turkey gizzard, if available
ingredients.sourceText: chicken or turkey gizzard, if available

steps: If using gizzards, boil them first until half-cooked and remove the tender parts.
Mince all the organ meats, put them in a pan with a battuto of onion, prosciutto, and butter, and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg or spices.
When it begins to brown, sprinkle in a scant teaspoon of flour, mix to incorporate, and moisten with meat gravy or broth.
Boil, then gradually add beaten egg while stirring constantly until the mixture sets.
Remove from heat, add a pinch of parmesan cheese, and pour into a dish.
Cut stale bread into thick slices about one centimeter, remove the crust, and cut into cubes about the size of a 10-centimeter coin.
Mound the filling generously on one side of each bread cube and half an hour before frying, dust with flour and spread on a tray.
Generously pour beaten egg over them so the bread absorbs it and the filling remains covered and well-coated.
Fry in a pan, starting with the filling side down.

title: Bombe Composte (Composed Cheese and Mortadella Puffs)
description: Prepared with cheese, water, and flour.
steps: Put water on the fire with butter and salt
When it begins to boil, throw in the cheese in small pieces and immediately all the flour at once, stirring vigorously
Keep the paste on the fire about 10 minutes, stirring always, then let it cool
Work it much and in stages with a spoon, adding one egg at a time, first the yolk then the beaten white
When about to fry it, add the mortadella in dice about one centimeter wide
If the mixture turns out a bit too firm due to the flour quality or because the eggs were small, add another egg
You will obtain enough for six people
If these puffs turn out well, you will see them puff up and remain empty inside
Serve hot as a side to fried meat or liver, or mixed with any other fried dish

title: Bracioline alla Bartola (Braised Veal Rolls, Bartola Style)
description: A bread preparation made with veal or beef or meat, onion, and celery.

ingredients.name: veal or beef meat (fillet, round, rump, or leg), net weight without bone, 500 grams
ingredients.sourceText: veal or beef meat (fillet, round, rump, or leg), net weight without bone, 500 grams

ingredients.name: one rib of celery, about one hand's length
ingredients.sourceText: one rib of celery, about one hand's length

steps: Cut the meat into thick slices, almost a finger thick, to obtain no more than seven or eight braised rolls to which you endeavor to give a nice shape, and beat them with the back of a knife.

Make a mixture minced very finely with the prosciutto and the ingredients described above, then pour six tablespoons of oil in a sauté pan or copper pan on which, when cold, you will place the braised rolls spreading on each one a pinch of the said mixture.

Season them with little salt, pepper and only the flower of four or five cloves, and over high heat brown them from underneath, then turn them one by one with its mixture to brown this as well, and when it has softened sufficiently turn them back over so the mixture returns to the top picking up what has remained stuck to the pan, then bathe them with tomato juice or preserve dissolved in water, cover them and let them boil slowly for almost two hours; but half an hour before sending them to the table cook in the sauce of the same a large peeled potato and cut into ten or twelve pieces placing them in the spaces between one braised roll and the other.
It would be better to send them to the table in the vessel where they have been cooked; but if this is unseemly place them as they are in a serving dish with the potatoes around them.
This quantity is enough for four or five people, and it is not a dish to be despised, because it does not leave the stomach burdened.

title: Braciuola di Manzo alla Sautè o in Teglia (Beef Braciole, Sautéed or in a Pan)
description: Prepared with beef, butter, and salt.
steps: Beat it very well with the back of a knife.
Put it on the fire with a piece of butter proportioned to its size.
Season it with salt and pepper.
Turn it often so it browns on both sides.
When it has absorbed almost all the butter, moisten it twice with a few drops of water.
When cooked, sprinkle a pinch of chopped parsley over it.
Keep it on the fire for another moment and serve it with its sauce.
You can garnish it with fried potatoes if you like.

title: Braciuola di Manzo Ripiena Arrosto (Roasted Stuffed Beef Roulade)
description: Prepared with beef, fat, and parmesan cheese.

ingredients.name: One beef cutlet, the thickness of a finger, weighing about 500 grams
ingredients.sourceText: One beef cutlet, the thickness of a finger, weighing about 500 grams

ingredients.name: One ball of fresh bread crumb about the size of a fist
ingredients.sourceText: One ball of fresh bread crumb about the size of a fist

steps: Make a fine mixture with onion the size of a walnut, a little celery, carrot and parsley; put it on the fire with the said butter and, once browned, throw in the milk veal in pieces and the livers, a little salt and pepper for seasoning, cooking the meat with a little broth.
Remove it dry to mince it finely with the mezzaluna and in the remaining liquid make a thick paste with the bread crumb, moistening it with broth if needed.
Now make a single mixture with the minced meat, the paste, the egg, the Parmesan, the prosciutto and the tongue cut into dice.
Once the filling is composed this way, just dip the beef cutlet in water to be able to stretch it better, beat it with the back of the knife blade and flatten it with the blade.
Place the filling in the middle and form a roll that you will tie tightly like a salami first from the long side and then crosswise.
Thread it onto the spit along its length and roast it with oil and salt.
You will have a delicate roast which can serve six or seven people.

title: Braciuola Ripiena (Stuffed Braised Meat Roll)
description: A bread preparation made with meat, chicken breast, and butter.

ingredients.name: one large thin sheet of meat for braising
ingredients.sourceText: one large thin sheet of meat for braising

ingredients.name: chicken breast, cut into fillets thicker than one centimeter
ingredients.sourceText: chicken breast, cut into fillets thicker than one centimeter

steps: Cut the chicken breast and the mortadella and prosciutto slices into thick fillets.
Spread some of the prepared filling mixture on the meat sheet.
Arrange a third of the fillets on top, interspersing them, and spread more filling over them.
Repeat this layering process two more times.
Roll the meat sheet tightly around the filling (like a salami roll) and tie it securely with kitchen twine.
Heat 30 grams of butter in a pot and brown the roll, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Once browned, pour off the fat (which can be saved for other dishes).
Continue cooking for approximately three hours, adding broth gradually as needed.
Once cooled, remove the twine, slice into portions, and serve.
Serves 10 to 12 people, especially when garnished with meat gelatin.

title: Brioches
description: Prepared with beer, flour, and butter.
steps: Dissolve the beer yeast with lukewarm water in one quarter of the said flour; form it into a round small loaf of proper consistency, make a cross cut in it and place it to rise in a warm place inside a small copper pot with a veil of flour underneath

To the remaining flour make a well in the middle, place in it the sugar, salt and one egg, and with your fingers combine these three things together, then add the butter in small pieces and begin to knead the flour, first using the blade of a knife and then your hands, to form a dough which you will place in a bowl to work it better
Unite to this the risen small loaf, when it has grown double in size, and using your hand to work it a lot, add the other eggs one at a time

Then place the bowl in a warm and well-closed place, and when the dough has risen, spread it out somewhat and with it fill halfway about twenty buttered metal molds with ridges, which beforehand you will have buttered with liquid butter or lard and dusted with flour mixed with powdered sugar
Return them to rise, then glaze them and bake them in the oven or country oven

title: Budino alla Genovese (Genoese Pudding)
description: A pudding made with veal, chicken breast, and fat.
steps: Mince the veal, chicken breast, and prosciutto with a crescent-shaped knife. Place them in a mortar with the butter, Parmesan, a piece of bread crumb soaked in milk, and pound thoroughly until it can be passed through a sieve.
Place the sieved mixture in a bowl and add three tablespoons of béchamel (made to the consistency of a paste for this dish), the eggs, and nutmeg. Mix well.
Butter a smooth tin mold and place a sheet of buttered paper cut to size at the bottom. Pour in the mixture and cook in a bain-marie.
After unmolding, remove the paper and spread on that spot a sauce made from minced chicken liver cooked in broth.
Serve hot. If well made, it will be praised for its delicacy.
This serves six people.

title: Budino alla Napoletana (Neapolitan Pudding)
description: A pudding made with semolina, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: Short pastry crust, half the amount of recipe N. 589A
ingredients.sourceText: Short pastry crust, half the amount of recipe N. 589A

ingredients.name: Fruit preserves of various kinds such as raspberry, quince, apricot, etc.
ingredients.sourceText: Fruit preserves of various kinds such as raspberry, quince, apricot, etc.

steps: Cook the semolina in three glasses of milk, taking care that it does not become too firm
Remove from heat and season it with sugar, a pinch of salt and lemon zest; when it is no longer boiling, add three egg yolks and two egg whites, mixing everything well
Take a medium-sized copper baking dish, butter or lard it, and line it with a sheet of short pastry crust about half a scudo thick
Pour one third of the semolina into the dish and scatter over it, at some distance from one another, small pieces or spoonfuls of various fruit preserves such as raspberry, quince, apricots, etc.
Place a second and third layer on top of this first layer, always adorning them with the said preserves
Cover the top of the pudding with a sheet of the same pastry and moisten the edges with a finger dipped in water so that they stick together
Make some decorative marks, brush it with egg yolk and cook it in the oven
When you unmold it, dust it with powdered sugar and serve it cold
The preserves can be replaced with sultana raisins and candied fruit cut into pieces

title: Budino di Limone (Lemon Pudding)
description: A pudding made with lemon, sweet almonds, and rum or cognac.

ingredients.name: Sweet almonds with three bitter almonds, 170 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Sweet almonds with three bitter almonds, 170 grams

ingredients.name: rum or cognac
ingredients.sourceText: One teaspoon of rum or cognac

steps: Cook the lemon in water, for which two hours will be sufficient
Remove it dry and pass it through a sieve
However, before passing it taste it, because if it tasted too bitter you would need to keep it in fresh water until it had lost that unpleasant flavor
Add to it the sugar, the blanched and very finely pounded almonds, the six egg yolks and the rum
Mix everything well, beat the six egg whites and add them to the mixture which you will pour into a mold to cook it in the stove or in the oven
It can be served either hot or cold

steps: Lard the meat with the lard strips seasoned with salt and pepper
Make a battuto (soffritto) with the onion, carrot, and celery, chopping it coarsely
Place the battuto in a pot with 30 grams of butter and put the tied and seasoned meat on top
When the battuto is nearly consumed, wet it twice with a bit of cold water
Once the meat is colored and the battuto consumed, pour in two ladles of hot water
Cover the pot with double paper and let it boil slowly until the meat is cooked
Strain the sauce, remove the fat, and return it to the fire with another piece of butter
Season the sauce to taste and serve with a garnish of vegetables of your choice

title: Bue Garofanato (Beef with Cloves)
description: Prepared with beef, cloves, and wine.

ingredients.name: A nice piece of lean beef from the thigh or rump, about 1 kilogram
ingredients.sourceText: A nice piece of lean beef from the thigh or rump, about 1 kilogram

ingredients.name: Butter and oil in equal quantities
ingredients.sourceText: Butter and oil in equal quantities

steps: Take a fine piece of lean from the thigh or rump, beat it, and place it in wine to soak the evening for the following morning. Given that the piece is about one kilogram, lard it with lardons and four cloves, tie it and put it on the fire with half an onion cut into thin slices, butter and oil in equal quantities and salt it. Brown it on all sides and render the onion, pour a glass of water and, covering the mouth of the pot with a sheet of paper in two or three layers held firm by the lid, let it boil gently until cooked. Release it and serve it with its sauce all around, strained and degreased. The lardons of lard, as I have told you other times, it is good to keep them the thickness of a finger and season them with salt and pepper.

title: Cacciucco I (Tuscan Fish Stew)
description: Prepared with fish, onion, and tomatoes or tomato.

ingredients.name: tomatoes, in pieces, or tomato paste
ingredients.sourceText: 300 grams of tomatoes, in pieces, or tomato paste

steps: Finely chop half an onion and put it to fry gently with oil, parsley and two whole cloves of garlic.
As soon as the onion has taken on color, add 300 grams of tomatoes in pieces, or tomato paste, and season with salt and pepper.
Once the tomatoes are cooked, pour over them one finger of vinegar if it is strong, or two if it is weak, diluted in a good glass of water.
Let it boil for a few more minutes, then remove the garlic and pass the rest through a sieve, pressing well.

Put the strained liquid back on the fire, together with the fish you have ready, such as sole, red mullet, scorpionfish, dogfish, gobies, mantis shrimp, and other seasonal varieties, leaving small fish whole and cutting large ones into pieces.
Taste to see if the seasoning is right; but in any case it will not hurt to add a little oil, keeping rather sparing with the initial frying.

When the fish is cooked and the cacciucco is made, it is customary to bring it to the table in two separate serving dishes; in one the fish alone, in the other as many slices of bread, thick as a finger, as the remaining broth can soak, but first dry them by the fire without toasting them.

title: Cacciucco II (Lighter Tuscan Fish Stew)
description: Prepared with fish, liquid or white wine or red wine or water, and tomato or juice.

ingredients.name: one glass of liquid composed of one third dry white wine or red wine and the rest water
ingredients.sourceText: one glass of liquid composed of one third dry white wine or red wine and the rest water

steps: Pound in a mortar three large cloves of garlic and fresh or dried ginger, reducing it to powder.

Put this mixture on the fire in a terracotta pan or pot with oil in proportion, and when it has fried gently, pour in a glass of liquid made up of one third dry white wine or red wine and the rest water.
Place the fish in it, salt it and shortly after add tomato juice or tomato paste dissolved in a drop of water.
Boil over a strong fire, always keeping the pot covered, never touch the fish so as not to break it, and you will find it cooked in a few minutes.
Serve it as the previous one, with slices of bread set apart which you will dry first by the fire without toasting them.
If the fish, before cooking it, remains raw for several hours, it keeps better if salted; but then it is well to wash it before putting it on the fire.

title: Cacimperio (Cheese Fondue)
description: Prepared with cheese, egg yolks, and butter.

ingredients.name: Fontina cheese, trimmed of rind, 400 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Fontina cheese, trimmed of rind, 400 grams

steps: Cut the Fontina into small dice and keep it soaking in milk for two hours
Put the butter on the fire and when it has taken color, add the Fontina, but of the milk in which it has been soaking, keep only two spoonfuls
Work it well with a wooden spoon without letting it boil and when the cheese is completely melted, remove it from the fire to add the yolks
Put it back on the fire for a little while, stirring again and in winter, pour it into a warm serving dish
If it has turned out well it should be neither grainy nor stringy, but have the appearance of a dense cream

title: Cappone Arrosto Tartufato (Roasted Truffle-Stuffed Capon)
description: Prepared with capon, truffles, and wine.

ingredients.name: One capon with only the breast, that is empty, without the neck and legs, killed the day before, weighing about 800 grams
ingredients.sourceText: One capon with only the breast, that is empty, without the neck and legs, killed the day before, weighing about 800 grams

ingredients.name: Black or white truffles, fragrant, 250 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Black or white truffles, fragrant, 250 grams

steps: Keep the truffles large as walnuts, lightly peel them and throw the skin thus raw inside the capon; you can also insert some slices of raw truffle under the skin.
Put the butter on the fire and when it is melted throw in the truffles with the Marsala, salt and pepper for seasoning and, on high heat, let them boil for only two minutes, stirring them constantly.
Removed from the pan, let them cool until the fat is set and then pour everything into the capon, sewing it both in the lower part and in the front where the neck was removed.
Keep it in a cool place to cook it after 24 hours, giving it thus three days of aging.
If it were a pheasant or a turkey, regulate yourself in proportion. In winter, it is good to keep them filled three or four days before cooking them, indeed for the pheasant you must wait.

title: Cappone in Galantina (Capon in Galantine)
description: Prepared with capon, veal, and pork.

ingredients.name: one large capon, plucked (approximately 1.5 kilograms), emptied and deboned (resulting in 0.7 kilograms)
ingredients.sourceText: one large capon, plucked (approximately 1.5 kilograms), emptied and deboned (resulting in 0.7 kilograms)

ingredients.name: Pork and veal for the forcemeat, 200 grams total
ingredients.sourceText: Pork and veal for the forcemeat, 200 grams total

ingredients.name: Breadcrumb marrow soaked in broth, 60 grams
ingredients.sourceText: Breadcrumb marrow soaked in broth, 60 grams

steps: Cut the truffles into pieces the size of hazelnuts and blanch the pistachios in hot water to remove skins.
Cut the veal, pork, ham, and salted tongue into fillets the thickness of a finger and set aside after salting.
Make a forcemeat by pounding together 200 grams of pork and veal with 60 grams of breadcrumb marrow soaked in broth.
Add one egg, truffle skins, and scraps of tongue and ham to the forcemeat. Season with salt and pepper and pound until fine.
Pass the forcemeat through a sieve.
Lay out the deboned capon and salt it lightly.
Spread a thin layer of forcemeat on the capon, then arrange a layer of fillets interspersed with truffle pieces and pistachios.
Continue alternating layers of fillets and forcemeat, placing the young hen breast fillets toward the tail to avoid accumulating the same meat on the capon's breast.
Draw the sides of the capon together and sew it closed.
Tie it lengthwise with kitchen twine, wrap it tightly in a clean cloth, and tie both ends.
Boil in water for two and a half hours.
Remove from the cloth, rewrap it, and place it under a weight in a flat position for at least two hours to compress it into a flattened form.
The cooking water can be used for broth or gelatin.

title: Cappone in Vescica (Capon in Bladder)
description: Prepared with capon, beef or pork, and fat.

ingredients.name: one large, thick bladder of beef or pork without defects
ingredients.sourceText: one large, thick bladder of beef or pork without defects

ingredients.name: salt, 150 grams (plus a good handful for inside the capon)
ingredients.sourceText: salt, 150 grams (plus a good handful for inside the capon)

ingredients.name: prosciutto, 150 grams (sliced very thin, more lean than fat)
ingredients.sourceText: prosciutto, 150 grams (sliced very thin, more lean than fat)

ingredients.name: one wooden tube approximately one palm's length to serve as an air vent, shaped with a whistle-like mouth at top and a notch at bottom for tying
ingredients.sourceText: one wooden tube approximately one palm's length to serve as an air vent, shaped with a whistle-like mouth at top and a notch at bottom for tying

steps: Wash the bladder well in tepid water and soak it for one or two days.
Clean out the capon and remove the neck and legs.
Place a good handful of salt inside the capon, tuck in the leg joints, and fold the wings against the body so the tips do not pierce the bladder.
Sew closed the openings of the eviscerated cavity and neck.
Wrap the capon all over with 150 grams of thinly sliced prosciutto (more lean than fat), binding the slices tightly to the capon with twine.
Make a small incision in the bladder just large enough to fit the capon, then place the capon inside.
Sew the bladder closed.
Insert the wooden tube (with its whistle-mouth end on top and notched end at bottom) into the neck of the bladder and tie it in place.
Place the capon in a pot of tepid water and bring to a boil.
Boil gently for three continuous hours with the tube protruding, maintaining only small, sparse bubbles rising to the surface—this is the critical point.
If fat or other liquid comes from the tube, do not be concerned; collect it in a small pan.
Once cooked, let the capon cool in its water.
Serve the next day, discarding the prosciutto wrapper which will have lost its flavor.
Inside the capon you will find gelatin, and you may add additional gelatin as a garnish if desired.
Serves ten people.
